usage: agentbreeder knowledge status [-h] [--project DIR]
                                     [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--json]
                                     REF

positional arguments:
  REF                   knowledge/NAME or knowledge/NAME@X.Y.Z

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR         The directory with stack.yaml and registry/ (default:
                        .)
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        The stack environment (default: the only one services
                        up wrote)
  --json
